decisions.decision: Build it now, end to end. In cloud/src/jobs.ts, add `suppressEmails` and `suppressDomains` to ListInput. Fill them when the build-list job is queued, from the do-not-contact files the attendee uploaded on D1.09. Read those files from wherever D1.09 saves them (R2 or D1); if the centre stores no files yet, add the upload so they are saved per attendee. Lowercase every entry. A domain matches itself and its subdomains, the same way customerDomains already works. In excluded(), drop any row that matches, before the sample and before approval, and mark it with its own batch value 'suppressed' so it can be counted. Show 'N rows removed by your do-not-contact files' on D1.11. Write a sim probe: one suppressed email and one suppressed domain must both come out of the list, and the count must show. Run the probe and the existing list probes on the local stack, commit, push, deploy the centre Worker, then move the task to review with Adi.
decisions.why: Spec T-495. The work is all on our own systems: jobs.ts buildList/excluded only checks exclusions, countries and customerDomains. D1.09 already collects the suppress files (DECISIONS_FOR_ADI, session 2026-10-21). orchestrator-autonomy says build fully.
